name: Question 2
problem:
Consider the system of linear equations

$$
{\begin{aligned} & 2x+8y=-6 \\  & -4x-16y=12 \\  & 6x+24y=-18.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard Gauss-Jordan method to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to reduced row echelon form, and then solve the linear system.

Question 2

Consider the system of linear equations {2x+8y=−6−4x−16y=126x+24y=−18. Use the standard Gauss-Jordan method to reduce the augmented matrix M of the system to reduced row echelon form, and then solve the linear system.

a
No solution
b
[3−4yy],y∈(−∞,∞)
c
[−4y−3y],y∈(−∞,∞)
d
[4y−3y],y∈(−∞,∞)
e
[4y+3y],y∈(−∞,∞)
